description: Namur 3D - Bâtiments texturés par dalle de 200m is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Namur. Modélisation de toute la commune de Namur en 3D LOD2.2 Toutes les faces de bâtiments sont texturées en couleurs. Un premier format de données disponible est le CityGML. Namur a été découpé en dalle de 200m de coté. Pour chacune, un fichier ZIP est disponible. Coverage: Namur. The portal files it under Urbanisme, Patrimoine. Its keywords are 3D, bâtiment, maison, texture, modélisation, Pavillon. The portal shows 2,485 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-06-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support building stock, energy use and retrofit studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
